scope: V26c PBL shared-matrix source correction and all-pair horizontal diffusion precision integration; read-only source review. No model run performed by reviewer.

candidate.compiler: pinned Intel ifx 2026.0.0; selected-object overlay build, not a clean build

review_findings.finding: The PBL payload transformer originally appended positional actual arguments after keyword actuals in the solve-to-part1 call. That call already ended with f_flux=, aerocu=, restart_flag=, and feedback_is_ready=; Fortran requires subsequent actual arguments to also be keyworded. V26c now forwards the new array, step, and phase by keyword. V26b's unrelated later build failure was the missing P_QNI/P_QIB imports in the all-pair selector; V26c's ONLY list includes both names and the pinned overlay build passes.

The Shinhong REAL64-vs-REAL32 source delta is computed for every cell/level where both paired channels are active, including nonzero pre-existing cloud/ice moments. This is an intentional full selected paired-operator precision correction, broader than only zero-base PR85 admissions. The original PR85 packet withholding still zeros both mapped deltas for rejected pairs. Treat this as an explicit candidate-wide numerical representation change; do not characterize it as a zero-base-only repair or as physical conservation.

The PBL ledger records the proposed rate correction amount dt * captured carrier * delta for each RK consumer. On the source-first path, an R32 virtual donor and bounded joint store can round or adjust the Q representation, so these sums are not an exact accounting of the final committed stored-field difference. They are useful signed operator-correction diagnostics, not a conservation proof or exact realized-storage delta.

Negative QV at PRE_RK is the in-place moist array after rk_update_scalar's RK1 predictor update, not a detached advection or positive-definite scratch array. It remains an intermediate predictor, not the completed timestep state because later RK stages have not run. Completed-state validity remains open until full timestep/end-stage audit evidence is available.

limitations: The pinned Intel PBL test extracts and exercises the original solver helpers plus delta arithmetic; consumer tests and source assertions cover routing and single application, but this does not establish full two-step model success.
The selected-object overlay build and these focused tests do not establish full clean-build equivalence or scientific approval.
